model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against the number of steps on the x-axis, which spans from 0 to 500. In this setting, both models exhibit a generally increasing trend in training rewards. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal line) starts at approximately 0.0 and rises to around 0.35, while the Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red line) begins slightly higher and reaches a peak near 0.4. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy consistently achieves higher rewards than Llama-On-Policy-Easy throughout the training process. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," uses the same y-axis scale (0.0 to 0.2) and x-axis (0 to 500). Here, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard (teal line) starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of about 0.02 around 50 steps, and then remains flat. In contrast, the Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line) starts at 0.0, increases steadily, and reaches a final reward of approximately 0.2 by 500 steps. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model demonstrates a significant improvement in performance compared to the Llama-On-Policy-Hard model in the more challenging training environment.
